name: mathd_algebra_478
informal_prefix: /-- The volume of a cone is given by the formula $V = \frac{1}{3}Bh$, where $B$ is the area of the base and $h$ is the height. The area of the base of a cone is 30 square units, and its height is 6.5 units. What is the number of cubic units in its volume? Show that it is 65.-/
formal_statement:
theorem mathd_algebra_478 (b h v : ℝ) (h₀ : 0 < b ∧ 0 < h ∧ 0 < v) (h₁ : v = 1 / 3 * (b * h))
    (h₂ : b = 30) (h₃ : h = 13 / 2) : v = 65 := by

name: aime_1983_p1
informal_prefix: /-- Let $x$, $y$ and $z$ all exceed $1$ and let $w$ be a positive number such that $\log_x w = 24$, $\log_y w = 40$ and $\log_{xyz} w = 12$. Find $\log_z w$. Show that it is 060.-/
formal_statement:
theorem aime_1983_p1 (x y z w : ℕ) (ht : 1 < x ∧ 1 < y ∧ 1 < z) (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (h0 : Real.log w / Real.log x = 24) (h1 : Real.log w / Real.log y = 40)
    (h2 : Real.log w / Real.log (x * y * z) = 12) : Real.log w / Real.log z = 60 := by
goal:
x y z w : ℕ
ht : 1 < x ∧ 1 < y ∧ 1 < z
hw : 0 ≤ w
h0 : (↑w).log / (↑x).log = 24
h1 : (↑w).log / (↑y).log = 40
h2 : (↑w).log / (↑x * ↑y * ↑z).log = 12
⊢ (↑w).log / (↑z).log = 60

name: amc12_2001_p5
informal_prefix:
/-- What is the product of all positive odd integers less than $10000$?

$\text{(A)}\ \dfrac{10000!}{(5000!)^2}\qquad \text{(B)}\ \dfrac{10000!}{2^{5000}}\qquad
\text{(C)}\ \dfrac{9999!}{2^{5000}}\qquad \text{(D)}\ \dfrac{10000!}{2^{5000} \cdot 5000!}\qquad
\text{(E)}\ \dfrac{5000!}{2^{5000}}$ Show that it is \text{(D)} \dfrac{10000!}{2^{5000} \cdot 5000!}.-/
formal_statement:
theorem amc12_2001_p5 :
    Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun x => ¬Even x) (Finset.range 10000)) (id : ℕ → ℕ) =
      10000! / (2 ^ 5000 * 5000!) := by

name: imo_1969_p2
informal_prefix: /-- Let $a_1, a_2,\cdots, a_n$ be real constants, $x$ a real variable, and $f(x)=\cos(a_1+x)+\frac{1}{2}\cos(a_2+x)+\frac{1}{4}\cos(a_3+x)+\cdots+\frac{1}{2^{n-1}}\cos(a_n+x).$ Given that $f(x_1)=f(x_2)=0,$ prove that $x_2-x_1=m\pi$ for some integer $m.$-/
formal_statement:
theorem imo_1969_p2 (m n : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (y : ℝ → ℝ) (h₀ : 0 < k)
    (h₁ : ∀ x, y x = ∑ i in Finset.range k, Real.cos (a i + x) / 2 ^ i) (h₂ : y m = 0)
    (h₃ : y n = 0) : ∃ t : ℤ, m - n = t * Real.pi := by
goal:
m n : ℝ
k : ℕ
a : ℕ → ℝ
y : ℝ → ℝ
h₀ : 0 < k
h₁ : ∀ (x : ℝ), y x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (a i + x).cos / 2 ^ i
h₂ : y m = 0
h₃ : y n = 0
⊢ ∃ t, m - n = ↑t * π

name: mathd_algebra_209
informal_prefix: /-- Suppose that $h(x)=f^{-1}(x)$. If $h(2)=10$, $h(10)=1$ and $h(1)=2$, what is $f(f(10))$? Show that it is 1.-/
formal_statement:
theorem mathd_algebra_209 (σ : Equiv ℝ ℝ) (h₀ : σ.2 2 = 10) (h₁ : σ.2 10 = 1) (h₂ : σ.2 1 = 2) :
    σ.1 (σ.1 10) = 1 := by
goal:
σ : ℝ ≃ ℝ
h₀ : σ.invFun 2 = 10
h₁ : σ.invFun 10 = 1
h₂ : σ.invFun 1 = 2
⊢ σ.toFun (σ.toFun 10) = 1

Determine when equality occurs.-/

    (h₃ : a < b + c) : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 * b * (a - b) + b ^ 2 * c * (b - c) + c ^ 2 * a * (c - a) := by
goal:
a b c : ℝ
h₀ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c
h₁ : c < a + b
h₂ : b < a + c
h₃ : a < b + c
⊢ 0 ≤ a ^ 2 * b * (a - b) + b ^ 2 * c * (b - c) + c ^ 2 * a * (c - a)
